title: The Baudhayana–Pythagoras Theorem
summary: In a right-angled triangle, a² + b² = c². Squares on sides, triples, testing right angles, and real problems.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 2: The Baudhayana–Pythagoras Theorem
Earlier NCERT Ch 6: The Triangle and its Properties

objectives: I can use a² + b² = c² to find a missing side.
I can test whether a triangle is right-angled.
I can solve real problems using the theorem.
misconceptions: The theorem works for every triangle.
To find a shorter side, you add the squares.
The hypotenuse can be any side.
